segments.text: I was discussing the Sunday picnic with my sister
If the weather is good, we will spend the day in the meadow by the river
If it rains, we will watch a movie at home
Unless it rains, we will leave the house at ten
In the morning, we discuss several conditions
And turn them into a clear plan
Tomorrow morning, unless the forecast turns much worse
If it does rain, however, we will shift the picnic to the afternoon
Whenever the forecast improves, our spirits rise with it
Although Mother was tired, she said she would prepare sandwiches
Filling an entire basket is always a pleasant one
As Sunday approaches, my sister's face remained calm
The fact that everything would depend
On the weather brought our family quietly together
